verdict.rationale: GoDaddy's docs explicitly describe a Search/check-availability operation, provide a working curl example (`/v3/domains/check-availability`), require Bearer PAT auth, and expose rate-limit headers and stable error codes for programmatic handling — all directly matching the story. Community reports raise trust concerns about GoDaddy buying domains after searches, but this is a business-practice issue, not evidence the check API fails to work as documented, so it doesn't downgrade the verdict, only confidence. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the endpoint's real-world rate limits/quotas and no third-party benchmark of accuracy/latency.
